analysis:
Only docs/architecture/inference.md changed. The supplied units are BASE text at lines 1636-2412, and the changed head ranges (404-413, 1095-1115) are not in the supplied units. The patch excerpt is truncated and describes two documentation changes. One covers load/eviction gating that releases retained free KV segments and the MLX buffer cache before eviction or refusal. The other describes segmented paged admission that parks released 64 MiB segments per pool, up to min(2 GiB, slot grant/8), outside the grant, floor and ledger charge. This is a documentation-only change, so there is no code or control regression I can cite.

The parked-segments description touches the memory-admission and availability posture (T-029, TB-007). It also touches T-028, which covers residual KV data in GPU memory. Parked segments are described as zero-filled on new installation, but the rest of the sentence is truncated, so I cannot confirm that residual K/V content is cleared before the next request reuses a segment. If the underlying code change in this PR parks segments across requests or tenants without clearing them, that could widen the T-028 residual-data exposure. The segments also sit outside the ledger charge. That is an accounting question, not evidence of a regression. The base text I reviewed (the native MiMo, Flint and Qwen4 sections, tool streaming, vision caps) is unchanged context, with no new security claims introduced by the PR.

Open questions for integration: whether parked segments are scrubbed or zero-filled before reuse across requests, and whether the exclusion from the ledger stays bounded under concurrent loads. I cannot verify either from the supplied evidence. Do not treat this pass as clearing the code changes that this documentation describes.
